assumptions.authorship: Original project-authored fictional rules; not fitted to observations or copied rows.
assumptions.budget: Independent choice None/1000/2000/7500/16000/24000GBP; constraints and boundary cases are intentionally overrepresented.
assumptions.coverage: Four unchanged legacy + 176 varied + 20 deliberate edge cases; quotas are not prevalence.
assumptions.electricity: Non-heating kWh=(900+550*occupants+4*area)*uniform(0.85,1.15). Occupants are latent fictional 1..min(5,max(1,floor(area/25))). Add electric heating demand where applicable.
assumptions.epc: Invented noisy ordinal label from fabric/glazing/heating/solar, not an EPC calculation or certificate. See docs/DEMO_CATALOGUE.md.
assumptions.heat: Space useful kWh = area * fabric intensity (poor150/partial100/good60) * exposure * glazing (single1.12/double1/triple0.92) * age (1:1.08/2:1.04/3:1/4:0.96) * uniform(0.8,1.2). Hot water = space*(1-space_fraction)/space_fraction; total useful heat is divided by boiler efficiency, SPF or resistance efficiency1.
assumptions.limitations: No empirical calibration, representative sampling, new accuracy evidence, real addresses, monthly histories, tariff assumptions or market premiums.
assumptions.masking: Null/unknown edge facts withheld after constructing the fictional baseline; retained latent traces are generation assumptions, never inference inputs for filling unknowns.
assumptions.permissions: Ordinary flats have no private roof access; other homes draw explicit permission (92%). Listed chance20% for age1; consent draw65%. Gas readiness draw80%. These draws are authored facts, not installation inference.
assumptions.pv: Grid imports=max(0,gross electricity - min(gross electricity,kWp*yield*self_consumption)); subtract once. Round annual fuels to nearest10kWh. Confirmed gas-free heating has gas0; missing meters are masked, never filled.
assumptions.randomness: Per-ID Python Random string seed: generator_version:seed:property_id. No clock input.
assumptions.space_heat_fraction: Gas uses0.8. For new electric homes, divide useful space heat by heating efficiency and rounded gross electricity (including appliances and hot water); round the fraction to8decimals. Existing PV uses the pre-PV denominator, not imports; electrical-demand retrofit effects remain unsupported. Legacy fractions unchanged.
assumptions.value: Fictional GBP=round((65000+1850*area)*(0.85+0.03*region_index)*uniform(0.85,1.15),-3), clipped75000..1500000. Index is a coverage ordering, not an estimated regional market gradient.

data_reuse_notice: Project-authored fictional demonstration inputs. Reuse with attribution to GreenHome Advisor and retain synthetic/demo-only/no-training and non-calibration disclosures. No third-party row rights are asserted.
label: 200 fictional England/Wales examples; not observed homes or training data.
ranking_warnings: Estimates under disclosed assumptions, not guaranteed outcomes.
Only supported catalogue measures are compared. Exclusions and confirmed constraints apply; unavailable evidence is not a zero-opportunity estimate.
Missing budgets mean no affordability constraint. Different stated budgets are not equal-cost comparisons.
Ranking percentages use 1e-9 percentage-point rounding (nearest, half-up) for both ordering and ties. Fuel savings, carbon and nominal package selection are not rounded by this policy.

schema.home: Existing HomeInput, synthetic_demo only; original four unchanged.
schema.ranking: Existing RankedHome with globally assigned competition ranks.
